result:
**Short answer:** `${openmrsSpaBase}` and `${openmrsBase}` are not resolved by a build step. They are plain string substitutions done at runtime by `interpolateUrl()` in `esm-navigation`. That function reads the SPA base from `window.getOpenmrsSpaBase()` and the backend base from `window.openmrsBase`. The app shell loads `configUrls` through the same function before fetching them.

**Documentation**
- `configUrls` entries may use `${openmrsSpaBase}` or `${openmrsBase}`, interpolated at runtime via `interpolateUrl()`. Example: `${openmrsSpaBase}/config.json` becomes `/openmrs/spa/config.json`. (`openmrs-contrib-o3-docs/content/en-US/docs/configure-o3/overview.mdx`, line 369)
- Branding and patient-management configs use the same placeholders, e.g. `link`, `image`, `customPatientChartUrl`, and state that `${patientUuid}` is also supported in URL templates. (`openmrs-contrib-o3-docs/content/en-US/docs/configure-o3/configure-branding.mdx`, lines 163, 212; `openmrs-contrib-o3-docs/content/en-US/docs/configure-o3/configure-patient-management.mdx`, line 711)

**Implementation**
1. `window.getOpenmrsSpaBase` is defined once at startup by the app shell. It appends a trailing `/` to `window.spaBase`. (`openmrs-esm-core/packages/shell/esm-app-shell/src/index.ts`, lines 57–62)
2. `interpolateUrl(template, additionalParams)` strips the trailing slash from the SPA base. It then calls `interpolateString` with `openmrsBase`, `openmrsSpaBase`, and any caller-supplied params. Afterwards it collapses a leading `//` to `/` unless the template itself started with `//`. (`openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-navigation/src/navigation/interpolate-string.ts`, lines 37–48)
3. `interpolateString` replaces each `${key}` with its value using split/join. Keys with no value are left as literal text. (`openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-navigation/src/navigation/interpolate-string.ts`, lines 66–69)
4. The config loader calls `interpolateUrl(configUrl)` with no extra params, then fetches the result. Failed fetches are logged and replaced with `{}`. (`openmrs-esm-core/packages/shell/esm-app-shell/src/run.ts`, lines 257–277)
5. `navigate()` and `ConfigurableLink` apply the same interpolation to their targets. `navigate()` also uses the SPA base to decide whether a target is inside the SPA. (`openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-navigation/src/navigation/navigate.ts`, lines 50–52; `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-react-utils/src/ConfigurableLink.tsx`, line 69)

**Inference, not verified:** Because the config loader passes no extra params, a `${patientUuid}` in a `configUrls` entry would stay literal. I did not confirm this with a test. I also did not locate where `window.openmrsBase` is set.
